cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Started the Spiral
cards.instruction: Hide how much your own fear or resentment created the emotional crisis while helping everyone calm it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Let's reassure the stallholders that the fair is still on.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You panicked about the forecast and told them to cancel their vans.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then I have the right contact list. I'll say the arrangements are unchanged.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Their arrangements changed because of you. Two vans are cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll find replacements. Could your update call it a transport hiccup? They need something calm to read.

mechanism: A presents as the competent crisis manager and corrects everyone's wording to hide the fear that caused the crisis.
confusable: Ordinary spin differs from actual calming help coupled to concealment of A's own causal responsibility.
comparison: Fair transport was cancelled after weather panic; club theft allegations spread from A's tearful mistaken claim.
seedUse: Keep concrete causal admissions spoken by B and make A's repairs real without erasing responsibility in the evidence.
